title: Paul Buchheit at Startup School 08
summary: Paul Buchheit, creator of Gmail and founder of FriendFeed, speaks at Startup School 08 about listening to users. He covers feedback, features, aiming for 100 happy users, and treating "that's impossible" as a statement of limited experience.
why: HN commenters cite it for its memorable lines on advice, limited experience and early user focus, and rewatch it as a reminder not to be prescriptive.

quote.text: I watch the video every once in a while to remind myself not to be similarly prescriptive
